verdict.rationale: Grafana Tempo and Cloud Traces document linking tracing data with logs and metrics, and exemplars let users jump from metrics to traces. The Knowledge Graph also connects metrics, logs and traces in one workflow. However, the evidence never describes a span-level jump to that span's correlated logs and metrics, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of span-to-logs and span-to-metrics navigation (e.g. trace-to-logs configuration), details on how a single request is followed end to end, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end
